scripts.text:
[Edgar]
So are you heading to Alberta again? Let me give you the same discount and only charge 250 Zeny, just like the last time.
How's that sound?
scripts.translation:
[埃德加]
你又要去艾尔贝塔吗？
和上次一样，我给你打个折，只收250 Zeny。
怎么样？

scripts.text: Alrighty~!
scripts.translation: 好啊~！

scripts.text: Why are you being so nice to me?!
scripts.translation: 你为什么对我这么好？！

scripts.text:
[Edgar]
Um...
This isn't
enough money.
Why don't you go
get some more cash?
scripts.translation:
[埃德加]
嗯...
钱不够啊。
你再去弄点钱吧？

scripts.text:
[Edgar]
It's just the way I am. That, and your devilish smile reminds me of my beloved blond haired son who left home years ago to become a Sailor on his own ship. Bless his soul, wherever he is.
scripts.translation:
[埃德加]
我只是天性如此。而且你那恶魔般的微笑，让我想起了我亲爱的金发儿子。他几年前离家出走，成了自己船上的水手。愿他安息，无论他在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Edgar]
My town, Izlude, is connected to Alberta by the harbor in the West. There is so much traffic between us, I almost become an Albertian.  Hehehe~
scripts.translation:
[埃德加]
我的城镇，依斯鲁得岛，通过西边的港口与艾尔贝塔相连。我们之间的往来非常频繁，我几乎都快变成艾尔贝塔人了。呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Edgar]
There's this guy I know pretty well, Phelix, who lives in Alberta. That guy is really stingy... He charges for everything!
scripts.translation:
[埃德加]
我有个很熟的人，叫菲利克斯，住在艾尔贝塔。那个人真的很小气...什么都要收钱！

scripts.text:
[Edgar]
But he's really a nice guy and likes helping other people. He has a good heart and will give you his support if you meet his price.
scripts.translation:
[埃德加]
但他其实是个好人，喜欢帮助别人。他心地善良，只要你满足他的要求，他就会支持你。

scripts.text:
[Edgar]
Lately, people in Alberta say that he is really trying to help folks and that his demand for Jellopies is just a coverup.  Well, you should take a look at what he has to offer.
scripts.translation:
[埃德加]
最近，艾尔贝塔的人都说他真的很想帮助大家，而他索要果冻布丁只是借口。嗯，你应该去看看他有什么可以提供的。

scripts.text: Can you tell me how to get to Alberta?
scripts.translation: 你能告诉我怎么去艾尔贝塔吗？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Edgar]
Huh? Well, you can use your feet and just walk.  But if you have money, I'd like to suggest that you take a ship.
scripts.translation:
[埃德加]
咦？嗯，你可以用脚走。但如果你有闲钱，我建议坐船。

scripts.text: Okay, gotcha.
scripts.translation: 好的，明白了。

scripts.text: But I'm sick of walking and I'm broke!
scripts.translation: 但我讨厌走路，而且我没钱！

scripts.text:
[Edgar]
Alrighty, take care~
scripts.translation:
[埃德加]
好吧，保重~

scripts.text:
[Edgar]
Okay...
You don't want to walk AND you've got no cash, but you still want to go there? Oh geez...
scripts.translation:
[埃德加]
好吧...
你不想走路，又没钱，但还是想去？天哪...

scripts.text:
[Edgar]
Fine fine. Me, being the captain of a ship, can afford to bring you there at a lower price. How does 250 Zeny sound?
scripts.translation:
[埃德加]
行行行。作为船长，我可以给你个优惠价。250 Zeny怎么样？

scripts.text: Alrighty~!
scripts.translation: 好啊~！

scripts.text: Bah, what a rip off!!
scripts.translation: 哼，太贵了！！

scripts.text:
[Edgar]
Um...
This isn't
enough money.
Go and get
some more.
scripts.translation:
[埃德加]
嗯...
钱不够啊。
再去弄点吧。

scripts.text:
[Edgar]
Boy oh boy,
if you think
that's a rip off...
scripts.translation:
[埃德加]
天哪，
如果你觉得
这很贵...

scripts.text:
[Edgar]
Yeah, alright.
See you later~
scripts.translation:
[埃德加]
好吧，就这样。
回头见~
